locations.note: A flashback has Lara hunting the Philosopher's Stone in Rome's catacombs, pursued by old foes.
Teenage Lara follows Father Patrick to a haunted island off the Irish coast.
Young Lara sneaks into the naval base and aboard Admiral Yarofev's submarine to recover the Spear of Destiny, whose power destroys the boat.
Lara infiltrates the New York headquarters of her old mentor Von Croy to steal the Iris.
The Rome flashback ends in the Colosseum, where Lara fights for the Philosopher's Stone.

routes.name: Lara Croft
routes.note: Four remembered adventures: the catacombs and Colosseum of Rome, a Russian submarine in the Arctic, a haunted Irish island in her teens, and a heist at Von Croy's New York tower.
